question: What claim about the speaker's intention is at stake in promising to tell the arrangement of the yoginī row to the beloved?
premises: The arrangement of the yoginī row is the subject to be told.
The speaker intends to tell it.
It is to be told to the beloved.
inference: The speaker undertakes to disclose the arrangement of the yoginī row to the beloved.
uncertainties: The full content of that arrangement is not given in this verse.
plain_english: I shall tell you, O beloved, the arrangement of the yoginī row.
